input.description: Synthetic Extruder relations shaped from the current 2782-relation observation; this is not the T14a compact source.

candidate_contract.lookup: input-key relation index followed by stable relation-id selection
candidate_contract.enumeration: epoch-bound, relation-order view of every recipe
candidate_contract.invalidation: publishing a strictly newer epoch invalidates caches and prior enumeration views

client_gate.integrated_client: skip re-expansion and share the server publication

hybrid_boundary.rule: relation ordinal modulo hot_modulo equals zero
hybrid_boundary.eager_partition: hot relations materialize and index at publication
hybrid_boundary.long_tail_partition: all other relations retain indexed relation metadata and materialize per lookup/enumeration

retained_memory_protocol.isolation: one child JVM per candidate, scale, and sample
retained_memory_protocol.measurement: Total bytes from the post-GC JDK class histogram; benchmark-package class bytes are also retained as diagnostics.

winner_algorithm.normalization: for each metric divide by the best surviving candidate estimate, then minimize the candidate's worst normalized metric
winner_algorithm.error_band_tie: scores whose normalized worst-cost bands overlap are tied
winner_algorithm.production_guard: Never emit a production winner unless measurements were produced from input kind t14a_compact_relations.
